verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It identifies conjugacy-class sizes with indices of centralizers, observes that every nonsingleton conjugacy class has size divisible by p, and applies the resulting class equation modulo p to show that p divides |Z(G)|. Since the identity lies in Z(G), this divisibility implies |Z(G)| is at least p and hence Z(G) contains a nonidentity element. The statement is self-contained, all hypotheses are used appropriately, and no hard prohibition or reference issue occurs.
